summary: Better Home & Finance Holding Co filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 reporting an amendment to its existing broker agreement with Intuit Credit Karma. The partnership will expand to offer HELOC products under the 'Credit Karma Home Loans powered by Better' brand to Intuit Credit Karma's 140 million U.S. consumers, alongside existing refinance products. The filing contains no deal terms, pricing, or transaction structure. It is a routine business development disclosure, not a special situation. No activist, M&A, or capital markets event is present. What to watch: potential loan volume and revenue growth from the expanded partnership in coming quarters.
